blocks.text: Banda openly confesses fault, saying in effect that he is the Guru's servant and Sikh and begging to be forgiven for the pride and ridicule by which he had lived until now.
The Guru accepts the beginning of repentance but teaches that real discipleship is not easy: to become a Sikh one must surrender ego, possession, and self-will, not merely change outward speech.
This page therefore makes the conversion inward before it becomes political, grounding Banda’s future mission in humility rather than borrowed power.
